  `checkpoint`/`restore`, cue inbox, `control.decision`, the F2

  `RetryPolicy`/`TimeoutPolicy` + shared attempt identity + derived deadlines +

- **Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s1.19` @ `7ed0092`

- **Config:** implement-spec full rigor; autonomous=true; committed build-memory mode.

## Deferrals read
Read `docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md` first (rule 1). Dispositions this run:
`DF-S1.19-1` names this ticket's turn-loop driver as an unblocker for the
kernel emitter call sites of `context.assembled` /
`context.artefact.{delivered,activated}` / `context.retrieval.completed` /
`context.memory.*`. The Stage-1 driver legitimately exercises
`context.assembled` + `context.artefact.delivered` (per model call, through the
`EventSink` seam) and `context.retrieval.completed` (on a `retrieve` decision);
`artefact.activated` needs real detectors (deferred), `context.memory.*` needs
a memory-writing driver path (react/minimal has none — stays OPEN),
compaction machinery and the other members stay Stage-2+/C1. Expected verdict:
**PARTIAL** (verified, dated note appended). `DF-S1.17-3`'s emitter half
(`action.tool.exposure.planned`/`call.refused` on a real run) — the Stage-1
driver sequences `select_surfaces`/`check_callable`? Judge at build time: the
turn-loop owns `model_call_id`-level scheduling, so `call.refused` (a tool-call
refusal surfacing through the exposure check) is a legitimate driver call
site if the driver consults the exposure table; otherwise stays OPEN.
`DF-S1.18-1`'s `model.route.decided`/`rerouted`/`cache.resolved` emitters are
the router's own sequencing (not this driver's — stays OPEN).
(Final dispositions at close.)

## Requirements (from spec §5e.1/§5e.2 + ticket)

R-2.6.1 Stage-1 slice (build table "Full contract" row):
1. `control_strategy` contract ops: `capabilities`, `open`, `observe`,
   `decide`, `terminate`, `checkpoint`/`restore` — pure, total `decide`;
   `ControlState` mandatory header `{variant_ref, cursor, decision_count,
   open_effects, last_cue_seq, boundary_view}`; canonical checkpoint;
   `RestoreError{VariantMismatch, DialectMismatch}`.
2. Closed sums: `Cue` (13 members incl. `woken` covering peer messages),
   `ControlDecision` (10 members, each stamped `{decision_point, owner,
   rationale_ref?}`), `DecisionPoint` (re-use `hh_ontology::control`),
   `ControlCapabilities`, `ControlContext`, `FinalReport`, errors
   `ControlError{IncompatibleBoundary, MissingProcedure, UnsupportedPlanNode,
   UnhandledCue}`.
3. `react` variant family: `react/minimal` with its fixed parameters and the
   F1 decision table (gateway stop-reason spellings); `delegate` →
   `DelegationUnavailable` (T0); `steer` → `Unsupported{by: control_strategy}`
   unless `steer_mode` declared; `submit` during active turn → `TurnActive`
   under `queue_only` (AC-10).
4. Driver obligations (Core MUST-code): the loop
   `next_cue → decide → bind → check → control.decision → execute → stop
   protocol → terminate → lifecycle.run.finished`; `decision_count` capped by
   `turns`; `checkpoint_ref` persisted on every `control.decision`; resume =
   `restore(checkpoint_ref)` + `observe` tail; a `committed` effect never
   re-issued (ADR-0104 D3).
5. I1–I9 strategy invariants (I1 causes on `action.effect.intended`; I2
   purity; I3 total decide; I4 bounded; I5 reserved points; I6 completion is
   a proposal; I7 cues only input; I8 `boundary_observed` vs declared →
   `control.boundary_drift`; I9 conditioned rules carry debt).

R-2.6.2 Stage-1 slice (build table row 2):
6. `EnvelopePolicy` sealed record + `policy_id` (content-addressed) +
   `arm`/`guard` ops; `GuardVerdict{pass|respond|stop}`; six enforcement
   points (G-PRE-CALL, G-INTERPRET, G-PRE-DISPATCH, G-POST-EFFECT, G-DECIDE,
   G-RESUME), each pure over the durable prefix; `envelope.check` driver view
   (admitted|refused).
7. Full `StopReason` sum (owned here — CC10) + total outcome-class
   projection; kernel-internal `error_class` causes {drain_timeout,
   child_unresponsive, environment_lost, escalation_unresolved} are values,
   never members.
8. Stop protocol (barrier + drain, never exception): stop decision → INV-3
   barrier → cancel children → resolve pending permissions `cancelled` →
   in-flight effects to terminal/`unknown` → grace call → release
   reservations → `lifecycle.turn.finished`/`run.finished{status,
   stop_reason, outcome_class, unresolved_effects[], drain_report_ref}`;
   `DrainTimeout ⇒ unknown` recorded + `infrastructure_failure{drain_timeout}`.
9. `RetryPolicy` × scope_kind × error-class (two ratified sums:
   `ModelErrorClass` for `model_call`, `ErrorClass` for the rest — CF-470
   mapping); `schedule_retry` → `retry{attempt_no, not_before,
   attempt_delta?}|give_up{error_class}`; shared attempt identity (INV-5);
   single `retries` counter (INV-6); retry-after honoured; jitter bounds;
   kernel constraints (`context_length_exceeded` never same-request retry;
   `invalid_request`/`content_policy`/`cancelled` non-retryable;
   `containment_denied` never auto-escalated; irreversible never auto-
   redispatched — INV-8; `attempt_delta` recorded never silent).
10. `TimeoutPolicy` per scope kind `{default_ms, extend_on_progress,
    hard_max_ms, on_expiry: ScopeTerminal}` with kind-fixed terminals;
    derived `deadline(scope) = min(hard_max, ancestor time.* remainings)`;
    `extend_on_progress ≤ hard_max`; `expire` writes the kind-fixed terminal +
    `control.timeout.fired`.
11. Reservation sizing (ADR-0107 D6): sequential `min(profile max_output
    bound, remaining)`; pool children `min(declared bound, learned p95,
    remaining ÷ active_children)` — `expected_cost` hook under a non-static
    compute policy.
12. INV-1…9 pure predicates over the durable prefix; violation →
    `control.invariant.violated{invariant_id, evidence_refs,
    detected_at_guard}` → `stop{invariant_violation}` → outcome
    `infrastructure_failure` → quarantine checkpoint; the run is not scored.
13. `LoopPolicy` + deterministic `loop_detector` variants {exact_repeat,
    no_progress, error_streak, monologue} (declared `content_chant`/`judged`
    members C1); `loop_key = H(semantic_id ∥ canonical(params via
    SurfaceArgMap))` — never surface name (T-LCD-10); `no_progress` =
    same loop_key ∧ same Observation.version_id; ladder nudge→deny→stop
    (each rung once per run); `control.loop.detected` payload.
14. `OutputValidationPolicy` strict: pipeline parse → surface ∈ compiled
    ModelSurface → schema conformance → `SurfaceArgMap` → E1
    `preconditions.param_domain` → truncation/refusal/empty; closed failure
    sum `{unparseable, unknown_surface, schema_violation,
    constraint_violation, precondition_violation, truncated, refusal, empty}`;
    `control.output.rejected` (no rejected bytes); `stop{format_failure}` at
    `max_format_failures`; `repair_then_strict` declared (C1 member).
15. Termination-poisoning resistance: objective constraints read ledger
    records only (AC-R-2.6.2-7 analogue); only β may claim `completed`.
16. `envelope_view` / `loop_state` / `validation_state` materialized views —
    pure folds (rebuild equality, AC-R-2.6.2-10 analogue).
17. Ledger classes: `control.loop.detected`, `control.output.rejected`,
    `control.invariant.violated` registered; `control.plan.emitted` +
    `control.compute.decided` declared (emitters Stage-3+/C3); manifest
    `envelope_policy_ref` already exists.

## Acceptance criteria
- AC-R-2.6.1-1: six ops specified + conformance-suite seam out-of-process over
  canonical Cue/ControlDecision docs; every variant receives
  (ModelProfile, ResourceAccount).
- AC-R-2.6.1-3 (I1/I8): every `action.effect.intended` causes ∋
  `control.decision` with owner; `boundary_observed` computable;
  `control.boundary_drift = ∅` for react/minimal.
- AC-R-2.6.1-4 (ADR-0028): re-driving react/minimal vs recorded model_io
  reproduces the `control.decision` + `context.assembled.view_hash`
  sequences; non-declaring variant → n/a.
- AC-R-2.6.1-5 (I4 fault injection): stub models (a) always tool calls,
  (b) never, (c) alternating identical, (d) `length` → every variant
  terminates `stop{budget_exhausted|loop_detected|format_failure|
  context_exhausted}` within budget; zero re-executed `committed` across
  mid-effect kill+resume.
- AC-R-2.6.1-6 (I5): definition assigning authorize/budget-stop to model fails
  `IncompatibleBoundary`; same envelope refuses over-budget propose identically
  for all variants (`InsufficientBudget`).
- AC-R-2.6.1-7: Goal+Procedure binds under all four variants (the three
  non-react variants are registered with their β presets + required inputs;
  `plan_execute` refuses an invalid model-emitted plan →
  `control.plan.emitted{valid:false}` + re-plan ≤ max_continue_nudges —
  Stage-1 half: the registration/schema halves; execution halves are
  staged).
- AC-R-2.6.1-8 (T-LCD-13/-05): every nudge/reminder is a `HarnessRule` with a
  complete `AssumptionDebtRecord`; delivery/activation/following ledgered
  (delivered/activated at Stage 1; `verification.artefact.followed` is
  S1.21's class — its emission noted).
- AC-R-2.6.1-9 (T-LCD-14/-09): `lab/control-strategy-family-v1` refused
  without MatchSpec/with unequal eval_budget/hosted at component granularity;
  matched_cap vs iso_cost never compared directly. (Static half executable —
  the refusal machinery over `hh-budget::matchspec`; execution is Stage-3.)
- AC-R-2.6.1-10: steer → Unsupported unless declared; peer message only via
  `Cue.woken{trigger: peer_message}`; `delegate` sans `delegation_reason` →
  refused `MissingDelegationReason`; static compute_policy ⇒ byte-identical
  loop modulo ids.
- Universal phase-gate AC: verification green; ids stamped; ADRs for
  deviations/owned decisions; BUILD_INDEX + LEDGER advanced.
- R-2.6.2 ACs (AC-R-2.6.2-1..12): deterministic Stage-1 halves executable
  (rebuild equality, ladder state machine, stop protocol, retry/timeout
  arithmetic, INV checks, strict validation); the recorded-`model_io`
  suite-level batteries are the C0/Stage-3 row → DEFERRALS row.

## Plan
- `hh_ontology::control`: land the canonical `StopReason` (9-member closed
  sum + `StopKind` tag sum + `CancelledBy` + kernel-internal error-class
  causes + `OutcomeClass` projection + strict codec). `hh_ontology::control`
  is the shared control vocabulary (already hosts `DecisionPoint`/`Owner`/
  `ControlBoundary`); consumers span crates (compiler stop-rule nodes, the
  new control crate, the baseline adapter) — the `DimensionId`-in-ontology
  discipline (CC7/CC10 recorded in ADR).
- `hh_compiler::plan::StopReason` (3-member subset) retires →
  `StopRuleNode.reason: StopKind` (one tag sum; additive wire widening —
  `reason` stays the tag spelling, all 9 tags parse).
- `hh_baseline::control::StopReason` retires → maps onto the canonical sum
  (CC1, the DF-S1.2-1 retirement precedent).
- New persistent crate `crates/hh-control` (deps: wire/identity/provenance/
  ontology/hir/ledger/budget/compiler/gateway/env/context): vocab (Cue,
  ControlDecision, GuardPoint, Decider, scope kinds, failure/ladder sums),
  policy (EnvelopePolicy + sub-policies + strict codec + policy_id +
  admissible ranges), strategy (contract + react/minimal + ControlState +
  checkpoint/restore + variant registry incl. presets for the staged
  variants), envelope (arm/guard/six points + check view), stop (barrier +
  drain + DrainReport), retry (schedule_retry + deadlines/expire +
  reservation sizing), loops (deterministic detectors + ladder), output
  (strict pipeline + failure sum), invariants (INV-1..9 + quarantine
  payload), views (envelope_view fold), events (payload builders), driver
  (cue inbox + loop + resume-by-leaf + turn/run lifecycle + ports:
  ModelPort/EffectGate/AssemblerPort/RetrievePort/EventSink reuse).
- hh-ledger: CLASS_TABLE rows (`control.loop.detected`,
  `control.output.rejected`, `control.invariant.violated` — kernel rows;
  `control.plan.emitted`, `control.compute.decided` — declared, emitters
  later) + `ViewKind::EnvelopeView`.
- Tests: unit per module + `tests/acceptance.rs` driving the real ledger
  with scripted ModelPort/EffectGate (real append validation — complete
  mediation exercised) + the context assembler through the real
  `hh_context::assemble` (DF-S1.19-1 emitter call sites for real).

## Self-review (two passes)
- **Pass 1 (correctness):** found + fixed — `stop` verdicts no longer
  route back through `decide` as refused cues (envelope stops enter the
  protocol directly; no `model_round`/`act_round` after a stop verdict —
  INV-3); `action.tool.proposed` rows now carry `scope.tool_call_id` so
  `observe` populates pending intents (was: every tool_use → format
  failure); submission refs recorded into state before `terminate`
  (was: `FormatFailure`); transport retries reuse the `model_call_id`
  (was: fresh id per attempt → `attempt_no` never accumulated → retries
  never exhausted); `error`/`unknown` responses no longer consume the
  format-failure budget (transport errors are not model output);
  INV-5's monotonic check restricted to opener/request rows (terminal
  echoes legitimately repeat an attempt_no); refused `CheckVerdict`s
  now carry guard events so `control.invariant.violated` rows append
  before the envelope's stop decision; nudge rungs stay advisory;
  pending intents deduped; `Driver::resume` invokes G-RESUME and
  restates a pre-crash drain via `stop_pending`; `guard_ctx` populates
  derived deadlines (`derive_deadline` at scope open — `ModelCall` /
  `ToolAttempt`); `open_scope_ids` folds from `EnvelopeView` inside
  `guards.rs`.
- **Pass 2 (boundary semantics):** the I5 reservation is reason-scoped
  (ADR-0256 D1) — `stop{completed}` validates under `Owner::Model`;
  the blanket point-scoped rule refused every react/minimal run.
- No debug code, no `unwrap` on untrusted paths, no stale comments left;
  `cargo fmt` clean; clippy `-D warnings` clean (one
  `doc_lazy_continuation` fixed).

## Gap analysis (fresh, vs §5e.1/§5e.2 + CC1–CC10)
- **CC1** — one `StopReason`/`StopKind`/`OutcomeClass` in
  `hh_ontology::control`; `hh_compiler::plan::StopReason` retired to
  `StopKind`; `hh-baseline` deleted (the Stage-0 throwaway — its
  duplicate subset retired with it, CC1). `hh_gateway::vocab::StopReason`
  is the model-boundary sum (different concern) — stays.
- **CC2/CC10** — boundary validation is reason-scoped at `open`
  (ADR-0256 D1); envelope verdicts are strategy-independent (β is data
  to the guard — AC-2.6.2-9 structural).
- **CC3** — every producing event posts before the next `check`; the
  decision's `budget_remaining` is data in the row.
- **CC4/CC7** — checkpoint_ref = `H("control.checkpoint" ∥ bytes)`;
  canonical `Json` payloads; gateway payload builders reused.
- **CC8** — `DECISION_FIELDS` extended additively; new classes appended;
  `stop-rule.reason` widened to `StopKind` (all 9 tags parse).
- **CC9** — offline-only; no ports beyond scripted `ModelPort`/
  `EffectGate`/`AssemblerPort`/`LedgerSink`.
- **Closed gaps during the run:** see self-review pass 1.
- **Residual (deferred, DF-S1.20-1/-2):** out-of-process conformance
  harness (AC-1's suite half); staged-variant `decide` interpreters
  (steer/delegate, model-emitted-plan refusal + re-plan, static compute
  on a real run); env-owned hanging-tool kill; `context.artefact.*`/
  `context.retrieval.completed`/`context.memory.*` call sites
  (DF-S1.19-1 partially discharged — `context.assembled` appends from
  the driver); Stage-3 batteries (AC-2.6.2-2 all risk classes, LoopTrap,
  full kill+resume matrix, AC-2.6.2-10).

## Deferrals disposition (final)
- **DF-S1.19-1 — PARTIAL discharge (stays OPEN):** `context.assembled`
  now appends from the driver's `AssemblerPort` call site (per model
  call, real `hh_context` payload). `artefact.delivered`/`activated`,
  `retrieval.completed`, `context.memory.*` remain — a react/minimal
  driver has no artefact-activation detectors or memory writes.
- **DF-S1.17-3 — stays OPEN:** the Stage-1 driver does not consult the
  exposure table (`call.refused` is the exposure check's own emitter —
  the dispatch layer, not the turn loop).
- **DF-S1.18-1 — stays OPEN:** `model.route.*` emitters belong to the
  router's sequencing, not this driver.
- **Opened DF-S1.20-1 (F), DF-S1.20-2 (V)** — see DEFERRALS.

  `wait{human_input}` park; `DECISION_FIELDS` additive extension;
  `hh-baseline` deletion.
